cellularautomata.name: Cellular Automata: Local Rules, Global Patterns
cellularautomata.truth: Local rules, global patterns. Each cell knows only its neighbors, yet worlds emerge. Rule 110 is Turing complete—simple rules can compute anything.
cellularautomata.qfep_connection: Cellular automata demonstrate emergence—the E(S) term manifesting as complex global behavior from simple local entropy. They are laboratories for studying how order and chaos interact at the edge of computation.
cellularautomata.demonstration: Watch Game of Life emerge from four rules. See Rule 30 generate randomness from simplicity. Build patterns that compute.
cellularautomata.description: Emergent complexity from local rules. Each cell updates based only on its immediate neighbors, yet global structures—gliders, oscillators, even computers—emerge. This is computation at the edge of chaos.
